[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Elemental Destruction] Elemental Destruction buff also increased the damage of your Flame Shock damage over time.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Fire Watch] Fixed a bug where Explosive Charge Shrapnel ranged attack power scaling was lower than intended.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Fire Watch] Doubled the base damage of Explosive Charge Shrapnel.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Master of Shadows] Decreased base damage and scaling of Dark Intent by 15%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Shadow Visions] Shadow Visions empowers your Mind Blast to deal 60% increased damage. Down from 100%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Shadow Visions] Engulfing Shadows now increases the damage of your Vampiric Touch by 20%. Down from 30%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Thunder Slam] Increased scaling of Lightning Blade by 33%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Thunder Slam] Lightning Blade gains an additional 20% weapons damage scaling on all ranks.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Thunder Slam] Increased scaling of Thunder Slam by 33%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Thunder Slam] Thunder Slam gains an additional 15% weapon damage scaling on all ranks.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Razor Claws] Razor Claws stackable buff now increases your physical damage by 3% and the damage of your Bloodthirst by 5% per stack. Changed from 1 / 8 respectively.

[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Ragefire Nova] Ragefire Burn now increases the damage the target takes from your Fire Nova by 3% per stack. Down from 5%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Demonic Persistence] Increased the base damage and scaling of Wild Imp execute explosion by 30%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Exorcist's Slash] Exorcist's Slash now correctly interacts with Crusader Strike, the random proc will now grant you one charge of Crusader Strike.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Verdant Convergence] Fixed a bug where Druidic Overload chance would not properly triple on criticals.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Verdant Convergence] During Lunar Eclipse, Dawn generates every 4 seconds. Up from every 3 seconds.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Blood and Guts] Increased base damage and scaling of Mutilating Disembowel by 33%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Blood and Guts] Increased base damage and scaling of Executing Disembowel by 10%.

[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Dragon Warrior] Increased base damage and scaling of Dragon Roar by 20%. Its damage profile has been changed: It deals full damage with 5 enemies (5x the single target damage) and then gets an additional half as much with any additional enemies ([5+2.5]x the single target spread across all enemies hit). [Thrall Only][Pending restart][Heavyweight] Increased damage of Crush to 150%, up from 110%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Heavyweight] Now also decreases the rage cost of your Heroic Strike and Cleave abilities by 50%.

[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Soul of the Warden] Out of Knives now increases the energy cost of Fan of Knives by 4 per stack. Up from 3.

[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Booming Thunder] Booming Thunder damage against players has been increased to 8% per stack. Up from 5%.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Booming Thunder] Booming Thunder buff now increases critical strike damage by 2% per stack. Change from critical strike chance.
[Thrall Only][Pending restart][Trick Shots] Increased the duration of Trick Shot buff to 6 seconds. Up from 4.

0.description: [Pending Restart, Patch Update, Cache Clear] Global change that affects all creatures in the world - 1) Creatures with random movement will try to reach the edge of their wander distance, turn smoothly on each turning point, will take random/unpredictable points in their radius and stop from time to time. 2) Creatures with waypoint movement will make a smooth curve on each point, will be able to do 180 degrees turns smoothly, will not do a micro stop on each point of the path. Said changes are active when creature is in and out of combat. During combat creatures will smoothly turn towards their target instead of been instant, adding more realistic behaviour to their movement. Side not: This change does not affect in any way or form spell behaviour, frontal cone casts or frontal cleave spell, they will function as before.
